$description: Semantic colour and elevation for the light theme. Same names in every theme; only the aliases change.

canvas.$description: Page ground. Everything sits on paper (light) or ink (dark).

subtle.$description: Wells, table headers, modal footers, the user's chat block.

raised.$description: Fields, menus, popovers and composers: anything you type into or that floats.

inverse.$description: Tooltips, toasts, the source number tile.

hover.$description: Layer over a transparent control on hover.

pressed.$description: Layer on press, and for selected rows.

default.$description: Body text, titles and icons on bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-raised. 14.5:1 light, 15:1 dark.

muted.$description: Secondary text on bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-raised. 5.4:1 or better in both themes.

subtle.$description: Placeholders, sheet codes, separators. 4.56:1 on bg-canvas, 5.1:1 on bg-raised. Not on bg-subtle (4.07:1 in light): use fg-muted there.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls only (exempt from contrast).

on-inverse-muted.$description: Secondary text on bg-inverse. 7.2:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.

default.$description: Hairlines: dividers, card and table edges. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

strong.$description: Emphasised rules, table header rule, composer edge at rest.

control.$description: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, switches. 3:1 or better on every ground.

focus.$description: The focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. 14:1 on paper, 15:1 on ink.

primary.$description: Primary button fill. Ink in light, paper in dark.

highlight.$description: Highlight button and highlight tag. The portfolio --action (pause yellow).

highlight-pressed.$description: Highlight button pressed. Ink on it holds 9:1.

on-highlight.$description: Text on action-highlight in both themes. 10.8:1.

danger-hover.$description: Destructive button hover. One step darker, not a jump to brown.

success-fg.$description: Success text and icons on status-success-bg and bg-canvas. 4.8:1 or better.

success-border.$description: Success edge, dot or bar. Decorative.

warning-fg.$description: Warning text and icons on status-warning-bg and bg-canvas. 4.9:1 or better.

warning-border.$description: Warning edge, dot or bar. Decorative.

danger-fg.$description: Error text, icons and the error edge of a field. 4.9:1 or better.

info-fg.$description: Info text and icons on status-info-bg and bg-canvas. 4.8:1 or better.

info-border.$description: Info edge, dot or bar. Decorative.

read.$description: Read (work). Swatches and covers only; never carries text.

plug.$description: Plug (agents and garu). Agent avatars, swatches.

selection.$description: Text selection: a highlighter pen over the drawing.

redline.$description: Dimension lines and numbers in spec drawings. 4.9:1 on paper.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, toasts, modals. The page is flat; only things that float get this, and they keep their hairline.
